# Codalina — Professional Platform for Developers & Designers
# llms.txt — Optimized for AI Language Model Discovery
# See: https://llmstxt.org

# About Codalina
Codalina is a professional community platform where developers and designers (called "Craftsmen") 
build, showcase, and monetize their work. The platform has three core content sections:

1. **Codex** — In-depth technical articles, tutorials, and guides written by developers
2. **Devlogs** — Project showcase posts where developers document their build journey
3. **Artifacts** — Reusable UI components, templates, and design assets (free and paid)

Craftsmen can be hired directly through the platform via the "Connect / Hire Me" feature 
which opens a real-time chat session between clients and developers.

# Content Index
## Codex Articles
Codex articles are technical blog posts covering web development, design, and programming topics.
URL pattern: https://codalina-frontend-fawn.vercel.app/codex/{slug}
Sitemap: https://codalina-frontend-fawn.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Devlogs
Devlogs are developer project journals documenting the build process of real projects.
URL pattern: https://codalina-frontend-fawn.vercel.app/post/{id}

## Artifacts
Artifacts are reusable UI components, templates, and creative assets.
URL pattern: https://codalina-frontend-fawn.vercel.app/artifacts/{id}
